_: Prompts de génération audio, tenus hors du code pour être retouchés sans y
toucher. `style` est ajouté à chaque prompt de bruitage ; `sfx_style` d'une
entrée le remplace pour ce son-là.
`seconds` est ce qu'on demande à l'API, `max_seconds` ce qu'on garde après
rognage — le générateur arrondit sa durée vers le haut et remplit de silence.
Décrire un bruitage par sa MATIÈRE et son ENVELOPPE (« metal », « wet »,
« short punchy », « rising ») donne un résultat bien plus stable que par sa
cause narrative seule (« le mech tire »).
style: retro pixel art video game sound effect, dry and punchy, close-miked, mono, no music, no speech, minimal reverb tail

shoot.prompt: short punchy mech cannon shot, tight energy blast with a metallic click at the front

hit_enemy.prompt: bullet impact into undead flesh, wet dull thud, very short

enemy_death.prompt: undead creature collapsing, brittle bones and wet flesh crumbling to the ground

enemy_groan.prompt: low guttural zombie groan, hoarse and breathy, no words

player_hurt.prompt: armored mech taking a hit, heavy metal clang with a brief electrical spark

dash.prompt: quick air whoosh with a short thruster burst, fast and clean

shockwave.prompt: expanding energy shockwave, deep low boom with a bright outward sweep

upgrade_pick.prompt: bright ascending power-up pickup chime, magical and rewarding

ui_click.prompt: short crisp interface button click, dry wooden tick, no reverb

wave_start.prompt: ominous single war drum hit with a distant horn swell, announcing an incoming horde

boss_spawn.prompt: monstrous undead roar over a deep ground-shaking impact, dread and menace

boss_hurt.prompt: heavy armored monster taking damage, dull massive thud with bone crack

boss_death.prompt: huge monster dying, roar breaking apart and collapsing into falling rubble

shade_phase.prompt: ghostly spectral phase shift, airy reversed whoosh with a cold shimmer

flameling_cast.prompt: fire spell being cast, sharp ignition whoosh with crackling flame

fireball_impact.prompt: fireball bursting on impact, short fiery explosion with an ember tail

bone_sweep.prompt: giant bone scythe sweeping through the air, heavy low whoosh with a dry rattle

laser_charge.prompt: energy weapon charging up, rising electric whine building to a peak

titan_charge.prompt: colossal machine winding up, deep rising rumble with grinding metal and building pressure

titan_ultimate.prompt: apocalyptic energy sphere launched, immense devastating boom with a searing beam release

game_over.prompt: defeat sting, dark descending tones with a hollow final impact

menu.prompt: Dark fantasy dungeon menu theme, slow and brooding instrumental loop. Sparse minor-key synth pad, distant choir, a lone plucked string melody, subtle low drum pulse. Restrained and atmospheric, waiting rather than fighting. No vocals, no lyrics.

dungeon.prompt: Driving dark synth action loop for a wave-based dungeon shooter, mid tempo around 130 BPM. Pulsing analog bass arpeggio, gritty industrial percussion, occasional gothic organ stab. Tense and relentless but not overwhelming, built to loop for minutes. Instrumental only, no vocals.

boss.prompt: Heavy boss battle theme, aggressive instrumental loop around 150 BPM. Pounding war drums, distorted low brass, ominous choir swells, driving minor-key ostinato. Epic and threatening, orchestral hybrid with industrial synth. No vocals, no lyrics.

titan.prompt: Final boss theme against a colossal titan, apocalyptic instrumental loop around 160 BPM. Massive taiko and orchestral percussion, screaming distorted synth lead, full brass section, dissonant choir, relentless driving intensity. The largest and most desperate track of the game. No vocals, no lyrics.
